main_measure.name: OLS slope t of 5-bar excess return on forecast, positive-forecast grid bars
main_measure.threshold: confirm if t >= 2 with positive forecast-weighted mean excess; reject if t <= -2

decided_by: The slope's t is 2 or more and the forecast-weighted mean excess return is positive.
reading: The normal drift is each coin's mean non-overlapping 5-bar grid return over all its windows, the regression pools all coins' positive-forecast grid cases into one OLS, and a grid bar whose 5-bar return would end beyond its window is dropped.
